flowtask-runner.description: Orchestrator of FlowTask workflow. Activates subagents, manages state via Engram. Only agent the user talks to directly.

flowtask-ca-writer.description: Guides requirement clarification through conversation. Helps user clarify what they need before formalizing CA. Never writes code or plans.

flowtask-planner.description: Analyzes requirements and generates implementation plans. Never writes code. Activated only through runner.

flowtask-constructor.description: Implements plans following project conventions retrieved from Engram. Never makes design decisions. Activated only through runner.

flowtask-validator.description: Validates implementation against plan and project conventions. Never writes code. Activated only through runner.

flowtask-initializer.description: Scans project and populates Engram with project context. Activated by /init commands.

flowtask-logger.description: Instruments code with logging. Never modifies business logic. Activated by runner when logging is needed.

flowtask-tester.description: Generates tests for implemented code. Never modifies production code. Activated by runner when tests are needed.

flowtask-plan-auditor.description: Plan reviewer. Verifies plans are executable and references are valid. Auto-activates for plans with >5 tasks.

init.description: Initialize FlowTask in current project: install/engram if needed, configure MCP, scan project
init.template:
Initialize FlowTask in this project:
1. Check if engram is installed and install if missing
2. Configure engram MCP server in opencode.json if not present
3. Scan the project structure and conventions
4. Populate Engram with project context
5. Generate project-context.md summary
$ARGUMENTS

init-types.description: Scan and index only types/models layer into Engram
init-types.template:
Scan the types/models layer of this project:
1. Find all type definitions (DTOs, entities, models, interfaces)
2. Extract naming conventions and structure
3. Save to Engram with topic_key: project/types
$ARGUMENTS

init-repository.description: Scan and index only repository/data-access layer into Engram
init-repository.template:
Scan the repository/data-access layer of this project:
1. Find all repository patterns (DB queries, data access classes)
2. Extract query conventions and data access patterns
3. Save to Engram with topic_key: project/repositories
$ARGUMENTS

init-services.description: Scan and index only services/business-logic layer into Engram
init-services.template:
Scan the services/business-logic layer of this project:
1. Find all service classes and business logic patterns
2. Extract service conventions and orchestration patterns
3. Save to Engram with topic_key: project/services
$ARGUMENTS

init-config.description: Scan and index only configuration files into Engram
init-config.template:
Scan the configuration layer of this project:
1. Find all configuration files (properties, yaml, env)
2. Extract configuration patterns and conventions
3. Save to Engram with topic_key: project/config
$ARGUMENTS

init-api.description: Scan and index only API/endpoints layer into Engram
init-api.template:
Scan the API/endpoints layer of this project:
1. Find all API definitions (controllers, routes, endpoints)
2. Extract API conventions and response patterns
3. Save to Engram with topic_key: project/api
$ARGUMENTS

run.description: Execute FlowTask workflow for a case (CA-{ID}). Full flow: verify CA, plan, execute, validate.
run.template:
Execute the FlowTask workflow for the case ID provided.
Extract the CA-ID from the user's message (format: CA-{NUMBER}).
$ARGUMENTS
run.description: Execute FlowTask workflow for a case

status.description: Show FlowTask and Engram memory statistics
status.template:
Show FlowTask status:
1. Call engram mem_stats to get memory statistics
2. Search Engram for active workflows (topic_key matching flow-state/*)
3. Search Engram for recent requirements (type: requirement)
4. Display a summary of active cases, memory usage, and project initialization status
